subject: general
question: In May 2021, the Indian Navy launched Operation Samudra Setu-II by deploying ______ naval ships.
solution:
The answer is __**7.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Operation Samudra Setu-II** refers to the exercise of **shipment of liquid medical oxygen**-filled cryogenic containers and **associated medical equipment** from various countries.
 
• It involved **seven** Naval ships. They were:
 
 
• **Kolkata, Kochi, Talwar, Tabar, Trikand, Jalashwa and Airavat**
 
 
 
• The **supplies** were from **Qatar**, **Kuwait** & **Bahrain** in the West, and **Singapore** in the east.
 
• This operation played an **important role in the fight against Covid** (particularly the second wave).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Operation Samudra Setu** by the Indian Navy refers to **bringing back **around 4000 **Indian citizens stranded in neighbouring countries**, amidst COVID 19 outbreak.
 
• **Indian Armed forces** in the past has a record of many such rescue operations to bring back the stranded Indians in adverse conditions like wars and pandemic. Some of them are:
 
 
• **Operation Rahat **(2015)- Yemen
 
• **Operation Sukoon** (2006)- Beirut
